methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab signals institutional capacity-building outside traditional tech hubs, creating potential peer learning infrastructure that could distribute deep AI fluency beyond NoVA if resources and network effects sustain.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community AI workshops in Hampton Roads represent grassroots skill distribution efforts that could bridge the technology gap through accessible peer learning, testing whether local initiative can counter metro concentration without platform dependence.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's institutional AI partnership deepens Richmond's hub capability but risks creating another pocket of excellence rather than distribution mechanism unless AI Ready RVA actively extends beyond the metro core to surrounding communities.

signals.title: Digital Realty to buy Alexandria VC firm founded by Warner
signals.signal_reading: A $775M acquisition of Alexandria-based Columbia Capital by Digital Realty reinforces NoVA's venture capital and data infrastructure dominance, concentrating both financial and technical AI capabilities in the state's wealthiest corridor.

signals.title: Controversy continues over AI device installations in Roanoke - WSLS
signals.signal_reading: AI-powered surveillance device deployment in Roanoke demonstrates platform-delivered AI adoption that requires minimal local technical depth, signaling shallow but distributed capability through turnkey municipal technology procurement.
